metas.title: HTML meta title for the /stats page. Shown in browser tab and search engine results.
metas.description: HTML meta description for the /stats page. Shown in search engine results below the title. Should mention all four ECOS criteria: efficiency, sustainability, accessibility, and security.

body.h1: Page heading (H1). Shown at the top of the stats page. Describes the page as a statistical cross-section of the ECOS database.
body.md_1: Introductory paragraph below the H1. One to two sentences explaining what the page shows and how often the data is updated.
body.md_2: Explanatory text shown inside a collapsible accordion. Explains how to read the statistical indicators: mean, median, percentiles, and the violin-boxplot chart. Uses markdown formatting with bullet points and bold text for key terms. Preserve all markdown syntax.

sidebar.table_of_contents: Sidebar section label. Labels the table of contents navigation in the sidebar. Keep short.

elements.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb label. Shown in the page navigation path. Single word.
elements.accordion_label_1: Accordion toggle label. Shown on the collapsible panel containing the statistical explanation text (md_2). Should indicate the content explains how to read the data.

table_score_comparison.tsc_caption: Table caption for the benchmark statistics table. Describes what the table shows.
table_score_comparison.tsc_mean: Table row label. Identifies the arithmetic mean row.
table_score_comparison.tsc_distribution: Table row group label. Groups the percentile rows (p10–p90).
table_score_comparison.tsc_p90: Table row label. Identifies the 90th percentile row. Technical term, keep as 'p90'.
table_score_comparison.tsc_p75: Table row label. Identifies the 75th percentile row.
table_score_comparison.tsc_p50: Table row label. Identifies the median (50th percentile) row.
table_score_comparison.tsc_p25: Table row label. Identifies the 25th percentile row.
table_score_comparison.tsc_p10: Table row label. Identifies the 10th percentile row.
table_score_comparison.tsc_data: Table row group label. Groups the dataset metadata rows.
table_score_comparison.tsc_last_update: Table row label. Shows when the benchmark data was last updated.
table_score_comparison.tsc_n: Table row label. Shows the number of data points in the dataset. 'n' is a standard statistical symbol, keep it.

section_headers.stats_data: Section heading (H2). Title of the data and interpretation section.
section_headers.stats_main: Section heading (H2). Title of the overall ECOS score statistics section.
section_headers.stats_parts: Section heading (H2). Title of the section grouping all four ECOS category statistics.
section_headers.stats_e: Section heading (H3). Title of the Efficiency category statistics sub-section.
section_headers.stats_c: Section heading (H3). Title of the Clean/Sustainability category statistics sub-section. Uses the descriptive term (Sustainability/Nachhaltigkeit) rather than the ECOS code name (Clean) on this page.
section_headers.stats_o: Section heading (H3). Title of the Open/Openness category statistics sub-section. Uses the descriptive term (Openness/Offenheit) rather than the ECOS code name (Open) on this page.
section_headers.stats_s: Section heading (H3). Title of the Safe/Security category statistics sub-section. Uses the descriptive term (Security/Sicherheit) rather than the ECOS code name (Safe) on this page.

sidebar_labels.stats_data: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the data and interpretation section.
sidebar_labels.stats_main: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the overall score statistics section.
sidebar_labels.stats_parts: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the ECOS categories section. Shorter than the section heading — one word is fine.
sidebar_labels.stats_e: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the Efficiency sub-section.
sidebar_labels.stats_c: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the Sustainability sub-section.
sidebar_labels.stats_o: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the Openness sub-section.
sidebar_labels.stats_s: Sidebar navigation label. Links to the Security sub-section.
sidebar_labels.table_of_content: Sidebar section label. Labels the table of contents. Note: key has a typo ('table_of_content' vs 'table_of_contents') — do not change the key.

statistical_violin_boxplot.title: SVG/chart title attribute for the violin-boxplot chart. Short label used by screen readers and shown on hover.
statistical_violin_boxplot.aria_label: ARIA label for the violin-boxplot chart. Read aloud by screen readers. Describes the chart type and what it illustrates.
